summary: Verified Feb-2026 Threat Model Analyst Corrections feature is VISIBLE and FUNCTIONAL on the preview environment. Banner + all 5 REFINE buttons render at the top of /threat-model. Each finding's MITRE tag renders the large amber '✎ REFINE' button. CorrectionRefineModal opens with the 4-verdict picker and successfully submits (POST /api/corrections → 200). The submitted correction is applied to the analysis (ANALYST CORRECTIONS APPLIED (1) banner appears with the corr id).
